provenance.estimator: paired-anchor V_next fit on shared decks, fixed point solved in closed form; interval from a hand-level bootstrap of the whole fit
provenance.june_estimator_opponent_bug: June's estimator drove the non-FL side through RegularAiPolicy with opponent_board=None, which silently disabled every heads-up branch and left it on the two-generations-old solo torch/pickle chain, so the opponent busted 38.9% instead of 24.8% and the hero's FL EV came out ~1.1 points too high.
provenance.june_convergence_note: 10.227 was iteration five's average of a non-converged fixed-point walk (V_next has negative slope ~-0.14, so June's iterates alternated high-low-high); armB re-measures June's own arm properly at 10.250 [10.026, 10.491], confirming the gap is the opponent, not the solver.
provenance.caveat_training_constant: Every learned .bin in the current assembly was labelled under fl_ev(14)=10.227020614683454; adopting 9.109 changes what future labels and searches optimise, not what the frozen weights already encode.
provenance.history_policy: configs/fl_ev_regular_2k.json is retained unmodified as the historical record of the June calibration; this file supersedes it as the reader default.

source: Re-measurement of the direct FL-vs-normal HU fixed point against the current model assembly (armA, 2026-08-03). Supersedes configs/fl_ev_regular_2k.json (10.227020614683454), which stays on disk untouched as the historical record.
